blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
blocks.zh: AI被用于大部分临床试验管道. 然而,选择试验的统计设计是决定如何对人体进行药物剂量测试和评估的关键步骤,但几乎没有AI的进展. 鉴于LLMS在生物医学知识和统计推理方面的长处,LLMS似乎是自然适合的. 然而,目前没有适当的方法来评价这种能力,因为最近的监管和方法变化,最著名的是林业发展局的Optimus项目,重新界定了构成合理设计的内容,并使以前的许多设计过时。 为了为人工智能协助的试验设计打下基础,我们引入了TrialDesign Bench,该基准为617个一/一-二阶段肿瘤剂量测定试验,每个试验都配有符合林业发展局最新监管举措的专家认证参考设计。 这一参考标准是通过专家设计过程的正规化制定的。 我们评价了五个前沿有限责任公司,没有一个符合参考标准。 我们的通化实验将这一性能差距追溯到两个主要原因:从试验来源推断潜在的、没有记录的设计决定因素(提供这些要素可提高0.22的阶级平衡准确性)和结构化的决策树推理(+0.24)。 TrialDesign Bench为评价和增强AI辅助试验设计提供了一个可复制的,当代的标准目标.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Clinical trials are the gold standard for validating new therapeutics [ 4 ] . However, clinical trials are costly and often fail. It is estimated that the entire development process from discovery to bringing a drug to
market costs over $ 2.5 \$2.5 billion [ 2 ] . There are generally three phases in clinical trials [ 4 ] . More than 32 % 32\% of trials fail at Phase I alone [ 13 ] . Statistical design and planning are critical components of a clinical trial, determining how doses are selected and how safety and efficacy are evaluated throughout a study [ 4 ] . The chosen statistical design can substantially affect the accuracy of these assessments and the number of patients required to reach actionable conclusions, ultimately influencing development timelines, costs, and likelihood of success. In this paper, we focus on the design method selection for phase I oncology trials, where the primary objective is to identify an appropriate dose for subsequent studies while minimizing patient exposure to subtherapeutic or overly toxic doses [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
临床试验是验证新疗法的金本位[4]. 然而,临床试验费用高昂,往往失败。 据估计,从发现到将药物带到
市场成本超过25亿美元[2]。 临床试验一般有三个阶段[4]. 仅第一阶段就超过32%的32%的审判失败 [13]. 统计设计和规划是临床试验的关键组成部分,确定如何选择剂量,以及在整个研究中如何评价安全和有效性[4]。 选定的统计设计可大大影响这些评估的准确性以及得出可采取行动的结论所需的病人人数,最终影响发展时间表、费用和成功的可能性。 在本文中,我们侧重于第一阶段肿瘤学试验的设计方法选择,其首要目标是为以后的研究确定适当的剂量,同时尽量减少患者接触亚治疗或过毒性剂量[16]。

blocks.en:
Although AI is applied across different parts of the clinical trial pipeline, it has made little progress in the statistical design components of clinical trials, particularly the statistical method selection. Existing AI applications in clinical trial pipelines include patient-to-trial matching [ 6 ] and trial outcome
prediction [ 5 ] . The development of these tools benefits from readily available training and benchmark data derived from historical trials, where documentations of past decisions, outcomes, or annotations can often serve as supervision signals. These signals are largely invariant to changes in regulatory guidelines.
blocks.zh:
虽然AI适用于临床试验管道的不同部分,但在临床试验的统计设计部分,特别是统计方法的选择方面,却进展甚微. 临床试验管道中现有的AI应用包括病人与审判匹配[6]和审判结果
预言[5]. 这些工具的开发得益于从历史试验中获得的现成的培训和基准数据,其中记录过去的决定、结果或说明往往可作为监督信号。 这些信号在很大程度上对监管准则的变化不具有变化性.

blocks.en: By contrast, statistical design decisions cannot rely on historical trial designs as ground truth. Trial design selection is influenced by available statistical methods and more importantly, regulatory guidelines [ 4 ] . The design adopted in a historical study is not necessarily the design that would be recommended today. Statistical methodologies have been evolving from the traditional 3+3 design [ 8 ] , to Continual Reassessment Method [ 7 ] , and to the Bayesian Optimal Interval Design [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 相比之下,统计设计决定不能依靠历史试验设计作为地面真理. 试验设计选择受到现有统计方法的影响,更重要的是,管理准则[4]。 一项历史研究采用的设计不一定是今天建议的设计。 统计方法从传统的3+3设计[8],到连续的重新评估方法[7],以及巴伊西亚最佳间距设计[14],一直在不断演变.

blocks.en:
Project Optimus [ 10 ] , a landmark clinical trial design initiative published by the FDA, fundamentally breaks the traditional design paradigm. Since it is issued by the official regulatory agency, Project Optimus sets the standard for how current oncology trials are designed. It moves early-phase trials away from pursuing the maximum tolerated dose (MTD)
toward the optimal biological dose (OBD), which is to focus on both safety and efficacy rather than safety alone [ 3 ] . This objective defines what a reasonable trial design is. A design method well suited to identifying an MTD is not necessarily appropriate for identifying an OBD. The methodological standard has evolved alongside the objective. Regulatory recognition of contemporary Bayesian adaptive dose-finding designs was granted more recently, with BOIN receiving FDA Fit-for-Purpose designation in 2021 [ 11 ] and Bayesian design methods gaining broader recognition in the FDA’s 2026 guidance [ 12 ] . Bayesian adaptive trial designs take advantage of the Bayes’ theorem and incoming clinical data to continuously update probabilities of treatment outcomes and alter the specifics of trial implementation [ 12 ] .
Since both the design objective and the accepted methodology have changed fundamentally, the overwhelming majority of recorded trials can no longer serve as ground truth or training data for models expected to meet the latest clinical trial guidelines.
blocks.zh:
Optimus项目[10],FDA发布的标志性临床试验设计举措,从根本上打破了传统的设计范式. 由于由官方监管机构发布,"优化项目"为当前肿瘤试验的设计设定了标准. 它使早期试验不再追求最大容许剂量(MTD)
以最佳生物剂量(OBD)为重点,即既注重安全又注重功效,而不只是安全[3]。 这一目标界定了合理的试验设计是什么。 一种设计方法非常适合识别兆赫,不一定适合识别OBD。 方法标准与目标同时发展。 BOIN于2021年[11] 获得FDA适合用途命名, Bayesian设计方法在FDA 2026指导中获得了更广泛的认可。 Bayesian适应性试验设计利用Bayes定理和收到的临床数据,不断更新治疗结果的概率,并改变试验实施的细节[12].
由于设计目标和被接受的方法都发生了根本的变化,绝大多数记录的试验不再能够作为预期符合最新临床试验准则的模型的地面真相或培训数据。

blocks.en:
We introduce TrialDesignBench , the first benchmark for AI-assisted statistical design recommendation in clinical trials. Our contributions are as follows: 1. We curate a benchmark of 617 early-phase oncology dose-finding trials, each annotated with rich clinical information fields and paired with an expert-validated reference-standard design over 11 trial design method classes. The reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process and reflects Project Optimus guidelines. 2. We evaluate five frontier LLMs under tiered input information configurations that isolate the effects of clinical information availability and expert-derived design principles. No model matches the reference standard, demonstrating a substantial performance gap. 3. Through ablations, we identify two consistent bottlenecks in LLM-based design recommendation, recovering unrecorded, latent design information from source text ( + 0.22 +0.22 class-wise balanced accuracy when supplied) and structured decision-tree
reasoning ( + 0.24 +0.24 ).
blocks.zh:
在临床试验中, AI协助的统计设计建议的第一个基准。 我们的捐款如下: 1. 我们对617个早期肿瘤剂量调查试验的基准进行了研究,每个试验都附有丰富的临床信息领域说明,并在11个试验设计方法课上配以经专家鉴定的参考标准设计。 参考标准通过专家设计过程的正规化制定,并反映"优化项目"指南. 2. 我们在分层输入信息配置下评估五个前沿有限责任公司,这些结构将临床信息提供和专家设计原则的影响隔离开来。 没有任何模型与参考标准相匹配,显示出巨大的性能差距. 3. 通过模拟,我们找出了基于LLM的设计建议中两个一致的瓶颈,从源文本中恢复未记录、潜在的设计信息(在提供时+0.22+0.22分类平衡准确性)和结构化决策树
推理(+0.24+0.24).

blocks.en: Together, TrialDesignBench establishes a reproducible, modern-standard foundation for robust evaluation and future improvements in AI systems for statistical trial design.

blocks.en: 2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2 基准建设

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en:
We draw our sampling frame from the AACT database [ 9 ] ,
comprising approximately 70,810 interventional trial records (fetched on 28 May 2026). We
restrict the selection to Phase I and combined Phase I & II dose-finding interventional oncology trials with a linked publication on PubMed and a posted protocol and, where available, a statistical analysis plan (SAP). The registry reports information such as trial phase,
conditions, and interventions. Protocols and SAPs contain more crucial information, such as the dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) definition, the DLT assessment window, and the endpoints used to select the dose, for biostatisticians to perform trial design recommendation
(Section 4.1 ). As illustrated in Figure 1 , after applying
these filters, we derive 617 617 trials.

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmark Inputs
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准投入

blocks.en: For each trial, we curate three levels of trial attributes that reflect progressively richer information available during statistical design selection, enabling controlled evaluation of LLMs’ ability to recommend design methods by varying the amount of trial knowledge provided as input.
blocks.zh: 对于每个试验,我们研究了三个层次的试验属性,这些属性反映了统计设计选择期间可获得的逐渐丰富的信息,通过改变作为投入提供的试验知识的数量,能够对有限责任公司建议设计方法的能力进行有控制的评价。

blocks.en: High-level trial information, including condition, intervention, phase, and objectives. These are typically communicated to biostatisticians during initial discussions with physician trialists. For benchmark curation, Basic Trial Context is extracted from ClinicalTrials.gov records.
blocks.zh: 高级别审判资料,包括条件、干预、阶段和目标。 在与医生试验员进行初步讨论时,通常会将这些通报给生物统计学家。 为了进行基准调查,从临床审判中提取基本审判背景。 政府记录.

blocks.en: More fine-grained trial information relevant to operational and planning details, including endpoint definition, treatment schedules, and other design-related characteristics enumerated in Appendix C . These details are typically documented during the very early phases of protocol development and before final decision on any statistical design selection. For benchmark curation, Trial Attributes are extracted from protocols and SAPs.
blocks.zh: 与业务和规划细节有关的更加精细的试验信息,包括终点定义、处理时间表和附录C所列与设计有关的其他特征。 这些细节通常在制定协议的最初阶段以及在就任何统计设计选择作出最后决定之前记录下来。 对于基准校准,从协议和SAP中提取试用属性。

blocks.en: Design-relevant attributes that are not explicitly described in protocols and SAPs but can be inferred . Examples include treatment regimen type (single agent vs. combination), inferred accrual rate, primary endpoint type (acute vs. delayed) [ 1 ] , and others (Appendix C ). These factors approximate information that trialists and biostatisticians often derive from domain knowledge when evaluating candidate statistical designs. For benchmark curation, such factors were inferred and validated based on basic trial context and trial attributes.
blocks.zh: 设计相关属性,在协议和SAP中没有明确描述,但可以推断. 例子包括治疗方法类型(单剂对组合),推断的应计率,主终点类型(急性对延迟)[1],以及其他(附录C)。 这些因素大致显示,在评价候选统计设计时,试验者和生物统计学家往往从领域知识中获取信息。 对于基准调查,根据基本审判背景和审判属性推断和验证了这些因素。

blocks.en: 2.3 Reference-standard Label
blocks.zh: 2.3 参考标准标签

blocks.en: The reference-standard recommendation for each trial is produced based on contemporary phase I dose-finding design principles developed and adopted by experienced trial methodologists and biostatisticians. Figure 2 summarizes this workflow as a decision tree adapted from modern dose-finding methodology [ 15 , 16 ] . The tree sequentially evaluates key Basic Trial Context, Trial Attributes, and Design Factors, a subset of the benchmark inputs described in Section 2.2 , ultimately leading to a recommended design method.
blocks.zh: 每次试验的参考标准建议是根据经验丰富的试验方法学家和生物统计学家制定和通过的当代第一阶段剂量调查设计原则提出的。 图2概括了这一工作流程,作为根据现代剂量调查方法[15、16]加以调整的决定树。 该树依次评价关键的基本试验背景、试验属性和设计因素,这是第2.2节所述基准投入的一个子集,最终导致建议的设计方法。

blocks.en: The benchmark output is a single reference-standard design recommendation. Each recommendation corresponds to a specific dose-finding method, such as BOIN, 3+3, or CRM. Although a single method is assigned to each trial, multiple methods may represent reasonable choices to the same dose-finding problem. Methods grouped in the same leaf node of the decision workflow (Figure 2 ) are grouped into a class, reflecting shared design objectives and methodological characteristics.
blocks.zh: 基准产出是单一参考标准设计建议。 每项建议都对应特定剂量测定方法,如BOIN,3+3或CRM. 虽然每次试验都指定了一种单一的方法,但多种方法可能代表同一剂量测定问题的合理选择。 在决策工作流程的同一叶节点(图2)中划分的方法分为一类,反映了共同的设计目标和方法特点。

blocks.en: The resulting reference-standard recommendations were subsequently reviewed and validated by experienced trial methodologists and biostatisticians to ensure consistency with contemporary methodological standards rather than historical practice. The node-resolution rules, in particular the late-onset determination (Appendix E.2 ), were calibrated against case sets labeled by these experts, and the experts re-verified the single-agent-versus-combination node for every trial initially labeled with a combination design, which reassigned 31 of 51 such trials to single-agent designs. The complete decision rules are provided in Appendix E , and the label distribution is reported in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate frontier LLMs on TrialDesignBench to establish baseline performance for AI-assisted statistical trial design recommendation. In addition, we investigate how recommendation quality changes as progressively richer trial information becomes available and whether expert-guided decision-tree reasoning improves performance. Our experiments aim to (1) quantify the current capabilities of LLMs on statistical trial design recommendation, (2) assess whether LLM performance improves with increasingly detailed trial information and access to expert-derived design principles encoded in Figure 2 , and (3) identify common failure modes in model reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们评估 " 边疆有限责任公司 " 的 " 试设计本 " ,以确定AI协助的统计试验设计建议的基准性能。 此外,我们调查如何随着审判信息逐渐丰富而改变建议的质量,以及专家指导的决定树推理是否改善了业绩。 我们的实验旨在:(1)量化LLMs目前对统计试验设计建议的能力;(2)评估LLM性能是否随着越来越详细的试验信息以及图2中编码的专家衍生设计原则的获取而得到改善;(3)确定模型推理中常见的故障模式.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式选择

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the performance of popular LLMs on trial design recommendation, we select Claude Opus 5, GPT-5, OpenAI o3, OpenAI gpt-oss-120b, and Llama 4 Maverick.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our benchmark has several limitations. First, we recommend a single reference-standard trial design when multiple design methods are often admissible. We address this by grouping multiple design methods into the same class in the workflow and running experiments within defined design-method classes. Second, to construct the first benchmark dataset, we restrict the scope to a more homogeneous set of Phase I/I–II oncology dose-finding trials to ensure high-quality extraction of trial information and design method recommendations. For the same purpose, we select trials with a linked publication and a posted protocol so that trial information can be more accurately derived without significant loss of representativeness or generalizability for the purpose of benchmarking.
blocks.zh: 我们的基准有几个局限性。 第一,我们建议在多种设计方法往往可以接受的情况下采用单一的参照标准试验设计。 我们通过在工作流程中将多种设计方法分组为同一类,并在确定的设计方法类中进行实验来解决这个问题。 第二,为了构建第一个基准数据集,我们把范围限制在一套更为一致的第一/一至二阶段肿瘤剂量测定试验,以确保高质量地提取试验信息和设计方法建议。 为了同一目的,我们选择了有链接出版物和张贴协议的审判,以便更准确地获得审判信息,同时又不严重丧失代表性或通用性,以制定基准。

blocks.en: We will expand to a broader range of phase I–III trials, with or without protocol documents. A major challenge is that much design-relevant information is not explicitly reported in clinicaltrials.gov registry records. The current TrialDesignBench may serve as few-shot examples for automated inference of latent design factors, facilitating scalable benchmark development.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce TrialDesignBench , a benchmark of 617 617 Phase I and
Phase I/II oncology dose-finding trials paired with a rule-derived reference standard for the
recommended statistical design. The workflow that produces the benchmark is based on contemporary dose-finding methodology
rather than historically adopted practice. The benchmark reframes trial-design
recommendation as an evaluable task. It enables us to measure a suite of contemporary LLMs against it under common
class-wise criteria.

blocks.en: Responsible-Use Statement
blocks.zh: 负责任的使用说明

blocks.en:
TrialDesignBench is an evaluation benchmark, not a clinical decision tool.
Its reference-standard designs are a rule-based formalization of one specified expert workflow for contemporary Phase-I
dose-finding methodology. Although it is expert-validated, it is not a unique clinical gold standard and not a substitute for a qualified
biostatistician. No results here should inform a real trial without expert review.
Every evaluated model in this paper fails to match the reference standard and can be confidently
wrong. Therefore, unsupervised use risks propagating unsafe or inefficient designs. The
corpus is built from public AACT/ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed-linked protocols and
may inherit their selection and documentation biases. The corpus largely consists of completed and well-documented oncology
trials. We release processed data to facilitate future research on AI for clinical trial design. We recommend a domain
expert in the loop with calibrated uncertainty for any downstream use.
